# P27.3 — Export data-shaping: geometry, jurisdiction, dedup, coverage (LAUNCH.3)

## Summary

Turns the raw claim spine (1.15M claims; coordinates living as *text* in
`camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude` claims; all modeling tables empty) into the shaped
datasets the public surfaces need — **computed at read/export time, never materialized**
(ADR-092 / P27.1 posture: no sqitch change, no spine write, no `value_geom` edit).

A live run over hosted `sig-pg` produces: **89,722 publishable subjects → 87,375 geolocated
site observations**, **55 jurisdiction buckets** (first-class `unresolved` = 25,857), **2,677
multi-source coordinate cells** (6,934 sites — the cross-source dedup signal, observation-level
honest, nothing merged), **2,347 conflicted subjects** kept visible with `geometry: null`, and
denominator-bearing coverage aggregates with `is_population_total: false` throughout.
PROVISIONAL — the OSM land was still in flight (spine grew ~10k claims between runs);
settled numbers owed under D-P27.1-1.

Implements `docs/tickets/P27.3__export-data-shaping.md`
(`implement-spec spec=… live_verification=true`). Stacked on **P27.2**
(`devin/p27-2-maximize-publishable-scope`, PR #113).

## What changed

- **`exports/src/exports/shaping.py`** (new, ~1,400 lines) — the compute-on-read shaping layer:
  - **Geometry assembly** — parses `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude` text claims into
    points with full claim lineage (`claim_ids`, per-predicate observation envelopes);
    `policy.sensitivity.apply_tier` reduces precision per site tier (tier-0 full precision;
    tests pin tiers 1–3). Unparseable coordinates are unreported, never faked.
  - **Jurisdiction grouping** — `camera_jurisdiction` claims → named buckets; the literal
    `unresolved` source value is a first-class group; `(unasserted)`/`(conflicted)` buckets
    for missing/disagreeing evidence.
  - **Observation-level dedup** (ADR-092) — exact-coordinate `observation_group` keys link
    duplicate cameras across sources without merging; contradictions stay `conflicted` with
    all dissenting claims carried; "N observations / M sites / K multi-source cells" honesty
    totals in the manifest.
  - **Coverage aggregates** — every count a `PublishedAggregate` with a named denominator +
    `not_evaluable`; `CoverageMetric`-shaped rows matching `web/src/lib/metrics.ts`;
    `is_population_total` pinned false, no totals, no population estimates (§32/SIG-METRIC-008).
  - **Sources + freshness** — `inference.freshness.source_freshness` per source; unregistered
    predicates count as staleness-not-evaluable, never guessed.
  - **Sharing edges** — publishable `*sharing*`/`*partner*` claims → typed edges with the
    §29.3 access kinds; unclassifiable names emit `unclassified`, never coerced.
  - **Licence posture** — per-site effective SPDX set + `licence_conflict` via the real
    `compute_export_license` gate (ODbL stays ODbL; the compartment split is P27.4's).
  - **`run_shaping`** — `default_transaction_read_only` + `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY`
    snapshot so the disclosed watermark *is* the served state; optional `belief` pin
    (`sys_period @>`) for reproducible as-of datasets (SIG-EXPORT-003).
- **`api/src/api/store_pg.py`** — the `PgReadStore` reads P27.4 needs (store-only, not on the
  `ReadStore` protocol): `shaped_dataset()`, `publishable_scopes()`, `geolocated_sites()`,
  `publishable_jurisdictions()`, `sources_with_freshness()`, `sharing_edges()` — memoised
  against the spine watermark (P25.10 pattern; provably never stale under append-only).
- **`exports/src/exports/cli.py`** — `sig-exports shape --dsn … --as-of … --note … --out DIR`
  writes `sites.geojson`, `sites.json`, `jurisdictions.json`, `coverage.json`,
  `sources.json`, `sharing_edges.json`, `manifest.json` (the shaped intermediate P27.4
  consumes; password via `PGPASSWORD`, never in the DSN — HG-09).
- **Spec fold-backs (D-P27-SPEC-1, ADR-092 share)** — `SIG-RECON-058` (§29: public counts
  disclose observation-vs-resolved posture) + `SIG-EXPORT-012` (§38.1: public export is
  spine-read, shaped at build time); spec regenerated via `BUILD.sh`;
  `check_spec_src.py`/`check_coverage_matrix.py` bumped (671 → 673 ids), 2 coverage rows.
- **`exports/pyproject.toml`** + `uv.lock` — `sig-inference` workspace edge.
- **Tests** — `tests/exports/test_shaping.py` (29 pure tests) +
  `tests/db/test_shaping_spine.py` (6 Docker-gated seeded-spine tests: geometry, tiers,
  jurisdictions, contradictions, dedup framing, read-only proof, effective-rights fallback,
  `PgReadStore` enumeration). One latent flake fixed in `tests/db/test_audit_spine.py`
  (determinism assertion now excludes `generated_at`, which legitimately varies).

## Live verification (hosted `sig-pg`, PROVISIONAL)

Two runs via `cloud-sql-proxy` @ `127.0.0.1:5433`, read-only snapshot transactions:

| | run 1 `19:50:55Z` | run 2 `20:05:53Z` (committed) |
|---|---|---|
| spine watermark | claims=1,149,799 | claims=1,159,799 |
| claims shaped | 374,916 | 379,201 |
| subjects | 88,294 | 89,722 |
| geolocated | 85,946 | 87,375 |
| conflicted | 2,347 | 2,347 |
| multi-source cells | 2,677 | 2,677 |

The mid-run growth is the OSM land still in flight — evidence the PROVISIONAL label is
honest. Artifacts: `docs/build/reports/p27.3-shaped/` (small JSONs committed; the 373 MB
`sites.json` + 104 MB `sites.geojson` under gitignored `docs/build/logs/p27.3-shaped/`),
report `docs/build/reports/P27.3_LIVE_SHAPING.md`.
